prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent illustration for a mobile music sharing app, used as the central animated scene and on an exported result cover
Primary request: a beautifully crafted, playful miniature listening station that recalls a vintage jukebox and a vinyl turntable, with the warm character of music artwork rather than a corporate icon
Subject: one sculptural record player console in burnt orange enamel, dark plum side panels, a large midnight-black vinyl record with fine circular grooves and a warm cream center label, curved silver tonearm, two small tactile knobs and a speaker grille; a rose-pink record sleeve peeks behind it
Style/medium: premium art-directed 3D illustration, tactile lacquer, carefully modeled rounded edges, physically believable small shadows, slightly nostalgic, lively and charming
Composition/framing: single centered object, three-quarter view from slightly above, full object visible, approximately square silhouette, transparent background with soft contact shadow only; no floating detached props
Color palette: orange #ed642f, plum #62354b, warm cream #f7f0e7, rose #edc9d7, near-black #242426, touches of brushed silver
Lighting/mood: warm studio light, rich material depth, polished and inviting, crisp edges readable at 240px on a phone
Constraints: no words, no letters, no numerals, no logos, no people, no watermarks, no scene background, no gradient backdrop, no glow haze; actual transparent alpha
Output: one isolated production-quality illustration, not a UI screenshot
derivative: Resized to 640px (player) or 320px (trophy), WebP quality 88; alpha preserved.
